privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how you can control it.

sections.heading: What We Collect
paragraphs: Grandma collects the information you provide directly: your email address, name, and any health data you choose to log (cycle information, pregnancy details, child growth data, symptoms, notes).

We do not use analytics or advertising tools, and we do not track you across other apps or websites. We do not access your device's location or your contacts. If you type a city or address in your profile, we store that text.

sections.heading: How We Store Your Data
paragraphs: Your data lives in Supabase, a secure database infrastructure. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Your authentication credentials are hashed using bcrypt.
We use industry-standard security practices and regularly audit our infrastructure. Data is stored in EU-based servers to comply with GDPR requirements.

sections.heading: AI Processing
paragraphs: Some features use Claude, Anthropic's AI model. When you chat with Grandma, scan a meal or an exam, read personalised insights, or use automatic translation, the text, photo or summary of your logs needed for that feature is sent to Anthropic's API. Anthropic does not use data sent through its API to train its models.
This only happens when you use one of these features. Your health data may be included in chat context to give personalised answers; you can turn this off in Settings.

sections.heading: Payment Processing
paragraphs: Payments are processed through RevenueCat, which handles subscriptions across iOS and Android. We do not store your payment card details — all payment processing is handled by Apple Pay, Google Pay, or RevenueCat's secure payment infrastructure.

sections.heading: Service Providers
paragraphs: We share data only with the providers we need to run Grandma, and only for that purpose. We never sell your data.

Supabase stores your account, logs and photos. Anthropic processes the AI features described above. Sentry receives technical error reports, without your email, IP address or screen content. OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) receives the text you type when searching for a city or address. Expo delivers push notifications using your device's notification token. Apple and Google handle sign-in with Apple or Google when you choose it.

sections.heading: Health Data
paragraphs: We take health data seriously. Grandma is designed to be HIPAA-aware and GDPR-compliant:
We never sell your health data.
We never use your health data for advertising.
We never share your health data with third parties without your explicit consent.
Your health data is never used to train AI models.

sections.heading: Children's Data
paragraphs: Grandma helps you track your children's development. We take special care with children's data:
No advertising IDs are associated with child profiles.
No behavioral profiling is performed on children's data.
Child data is only visible to parents and explicitly authorized caregivers.
All child data can be exported or deleted at any time.

sections.heading: Data Export & Deletion
paragraphs: You have full control over your data:
Export all your data in the app: Profile › Data & Privacy › Export All Data.

Delete your entire account in the app: Profile › Account & Security › Delete Account. Children you added are deleted with it, and co-parents or caregivers you invited lose access. Your community posts, comments and listings are removed; channels you started stay for their members, without your name. Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription — cancel it in your store account. Can't open the app? Email grandma@sauceroom.co from your account email.
Deletion is permanent and completed within 30 days.

sections.heading: Care Circle Sharing
paragraphs: When you invite caregivers to your care circle, you control exactly what they can see. Permissions are granular — a nanny can log naps without seeing medical records. All sharing is opt-in and can be revoked at any time.

sections.heading: The waitlist
paragraphs: When you join the waitlist we store your email, your name if you give it, the chapter you chose, your country, the site language, whether you want the launch notice, where you came from (campaign tags and referring site) and a one-way hash of your IP address used only to prevent abuse.
We use this only to send your invite and, if you asked, one launch notice. We never sell it or share it for marketing.
To be removed, email grandma@sauceroom.co and we'll delete your entry.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at privacy@sauceroom.co

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Grandma, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Medical Disclaimer
paragraphs: Grandma is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician, midwife, or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you read or hear in Grandma.

sections.heading: Age Requirement
paragraphs: You must be at least 13 years old to use Grandma, or at least 16 if you live in the European Union, the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Canada. If you are under 18, you may only use Grandma with the involvement of a parent or guardian, and some features (the Village, Community, and intimacy logs) are not available. Parents and guardians are responsible for child data entered into the app.

sections.heading: Account Responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your failure to protect your account.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
paragraphs: You agree not to:
Use Grandma for any unlawful purpose.
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems.
Interfere with or disrupt the service.
Upload malicious content or code.
Impersonate others or misrepresent your identity.
Use the service to harass, abuse, or harm others.

sections.heading: Subscriptions & Payments
paragraphs: Grandma offers free and premium subscription tiers. Premium subscriptions are billed monthly or annually through Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel subscriptions through your device's app store settings.
Refunds are handled according to Apple/Google policies, or directly by us within 14 days of purchase.
Price changes will be communicated 30 days in advance.

sections.heading: AI-Generated Content
paragraphs: Grandma uses AI (powered by Claude from Anthropic) to provide information and support. AI responses:
Are not medical advice and should not be treated as such.
May contain inaccuracies or errors.
Should be verified with qualified professionals for important decisions.
Are provided "as is" without warranties of accuracy or completeness.

sections.heading: Your Content
paragraphs: You retain ownership of all content you create in Grandma (logs, notes, photos, etc.). By using the service, you grant us a limited license to store, process, and display your content as necessary to provide the service.
You can export or delete your content at any time. Upon account deletion, your content will be permanently removed within 30 days.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Grandma, including its design, features, and content (excluding your personal content), is owned by us and protected by intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works from our service without permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Grandma and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or revenues, whether incurred directly or indirectly, or any loss of data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses.

sections.heading: Service Modifications
paragraphs: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the service at any time. We will provide reasonable notice of significant changes. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of those changes.

sections.heading: Governing Law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Portugal. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Lisbon, Portugal.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, contact us at terms@sauceroom.co
